title: Why are these purple flowers shutting down streets in Sydney?
description: Jacaranda trees typically flower for six weeks every spring, drawing visitors to Australia from across the globe.
text: Sydney’s Jacaranda trees typically flower for six weeks every spring, turning the harbour city, and social media feeds, purple.
BBC journalist Tabby Wilson visits one of Australia’s most famous Jacaranda photo spots and speaks to visitors who have traveled from across the globe to see the blooms.
